items: IoU = intersection / union (0 to 1)
GIoU — rewards closer non-overlapping boxes
DIoU — adds center-distance penalty
CIoU — also accounts for aspect ratio
DIoU/CIoU loss converges faster than L2 on boxes
Tile the image with boxes of varied scales and ratios
Each anchor predicts offset + objectness + class
K-means on ground truth boxes finds good priors
Multi-scale anchors = feature pyramid network (FPN)
Anchor-free detectors (FCOS, CenterNet) skip this step
Sort predictions by confidence
Keep top box, remove others with IoU > threshold
Soft-NMS decays instead of removing
Matrix-NMS / DIoU-NMS — modern differentiable variants
Tune threshold per dataset (0.3–0.7 typical)
Grid-based predictions — one pass per image
Detection head: objectness + class + box offsets
Loss weights balance classification and regression
YOLOv3/v5/v8 — incremental accuracy & speed gains
Export to TFLite/ONNX for mobile and edge
Compute AP per class — area under PR curve
mAP = average across classes
mAP@0.5 (VOC) vs mAP@[0.5:0.95] (COCO)
Always report mAP alongside per-class F1
